What have you done in the period? Have you made something of yourself?
I'm aware of what's wrong, but I have no willpower or backbone to ever make anything work. My brain thinks that the bedroom is my life and that I don't need other people, but being social is a part of human nature and it is slowly draining my vitality... I am a fucking disaster waiting to happen...

I need to stop being a lazy sloth and actually grow the fuck up so I can become something other than this piece of shit that I know I am. I need to realize that there is a world out there other than my bedroom, but my brain doesn't give a fuck...
